tagline: Keep your keys. Keep your focus.
brief: A personal API-key vault for developers: encrypted storage, organized credentials, permission-based sharing, expiry reminders and activity history.
criteria: Match the existing olive website, remain readable in the sidebar and favicon, and identify credentials kept in a protected space.

concepts.name: Keyway
concepts.idea: A key-shaped channel cut into a protective enclosure.
rationale: The negative key and solid perimeter unite credentials and safekeeping.
The website palette and lowercase lettering keep the app recognizable.
A wider small-size cut preserves the opening in favicons and dark mode.

recommendation: Use the olive mark on warm light surfaces and the sage reversed mark on dark olive surfaces.
next_steps: Use the supplied SVG masters for digital layouts.
Keep clear space and use the small cut at 16 to 24 px.
See guidelines.md for the identity specification.
